title: F97.1 one skill, used in the chat that made it: what it builds

cards.title: Make a skill, use it at once
cards.text: The agent's tools and skills become one kind of skill, a chat uses the one it made straight away, and the next chat lists it by name.

cards.title: One shape
cards.text: Steps 1 to 7: the skill read from its folder, its arguments checked, run with JSON on stdin, approved ones listed by name.

cards.title: Draft and door
cards.text: Steps 8 to 13: CreateSkill drafts it, UseSkill runs it, /approve and /reject, and a note so the model knows.

cards.title: Old gone, docs, proof
cards.text: Steps 14 to 20: the old types gone, the agent's write-a-skill, the prompts, ADR 0033, the walk-through.
